title: Republic of the Rif
capsule: The Republic of the Rif (Tarifit Berber: ⵜⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷⴰ ⵏ ⴰⵔⵔⵉⴼ) was a confederate state in the Rif mountains of northern Morocco, proclaimed on 18 September 1921 by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Karim al-Khattabi after Riffian forces annihilated a Spanish expeditionary corps of roughly 20,000 troops at the Battle of Annual in July 1921. With its capital at Ajdir, the republic established a rudimentary government with ministries and a constitution, while repelling further Spanish offensives that employed mustard gas supplied from Germany. France joined the campaign in 1925 after Riffian advances crossed into the French Protectorate zone; a combined Franco-Spanish force of some 500,000 troops under Marshal Pétain forced Abd el-Krim's surrender on 26 May 1926, and he was exiled to Réunion.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The republic's highland territory in the central Rif is well attested from Spanish and French military cartography; its boundaries fluctuated with the front line and are not precisely fixed.
